name: Svaadh Kitchen
tagline: Wholesome homemade vegetarian meals, straight from our kitchen to your plate.

about.summary: Svaadh Kitchen is a home-based vegetarian cloud kitchen in Hadapsar, Pune, serving fresh and wholesome homemade meals since August 2023.
about.description: We specialize in homemade vegetarian food, offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner with a changing daily sabji menu — fully Make-Your-Own-Meal, no fixed thali. Our delivery network covers 14 major areas in Hadapsar, with Free Delivery for Bhosale Nagar, Triveni Nagar, and all Self Pickup orders. We serve Magarpatta, Amanora, DP Road, Malwadi, SadeSatraNali, Kirtane Baug, Tupe Patil Road, BG Shirke Road, Pune-Solapur Road (Magarpatta Bridge to Gadital only), Vihar Chowk, Mandai, and Gadital. Meals are cooked fresh daily in small batches using quality ingredients and traditional recipes.

locations_served: Pune-Solapur Road (Magarpatta Bridge to Gadital only)

order_cutoffs.note: Cutoffs are for same-day delivery. Future dates can be ordered any time. Occasionally the kitchen closes a specific day or a specific meal — closed days/meals are greyed out on the order calendar, and any already-placed orders for them are auto-cancelled with a full refund.

delivery.free_area: Bhosale Nagar, Triveni Nagar, Self Pickup — always free
delivery.delivery_charge: ₹11 per meal. Delivery becomes FREE when the day's food total reaches ₹106 (ordering 1 meal that day), ₹159 (2 meals) or ₹190 (3 meals). Always free for Bhosale Nagar, Triveni Nagar, and Self Pickup.
delivery.small_order_fee: A small ₹11 cart fee applies to a Lunch or Dinner meal whose food subtotal is below ₹53.
delivery.outside_service: We only deliver in listed Hadapsar areas.
delivery.per_meal_address: Each meal can go to a different address — breakfast at home, lunch at office, dinner back home.
delivery.delivery_full: On high-demand days, delivery slots for a meal can fill up. Orders of ₹200+ for that meal (₹100+ for breakfast) still get home delivery even when slots are full. Otherwise you can still order with free Self Pickup, or Porter (you book a courier from our kitchen and pay the courier directly — we add no fee).

menu.note: Today's sabji (dry and curry) changes daily and is shown in the order form. Breakfast items also rotate daily.
menu.breakfast: Rotating daily menu — items like Kanda Poha, Upma, Sabudana Khichdi, Paratha, Sheera (₹35–₹70 range). Check the order form for today's breakfast options.
menu.typical_meal: A typical veg meal of 2 Chapati + Full Sabji + Dal + Rice comes to about ₹105 before discounts. Build lighter or bigger — you only pay for what you pick.

bulk_plans.summary: Bulk meal plans — order many days in one go and save on every day's food. Lunch and/or Dinner; the sabji each day is the chef's special of the day.
bulk_plans.how_it_works: Pick a plan on the order page (⚡ Bulk card), choose your Lunch and/or Dinner items once, and the same meal is delivered every working day — Sundays and kitchen holidays are skipped automatically. The daily-total discount tiers stack on top of the plan discount.
bulk_plans.postpone: Change of plans? On the 15-Day plan you can postpone up to 2 lunch days + 2 dinner days to another date (within 30 days); on the Month plan up to 4 + 4. Postponing keeps the same items, price, and discount — no extra charge.
bulk_plans.cancellation: You can also cancel any individual day before its cutoff. Cancelling a day forfeits that meal's bulk discount (it's a commitment discount), and the rest is refunded.

discounts.tier1: 5% off when the day's food total is ₹325 or more
discounts.tier2: 7.5% off when the day's food total is ₹485 or more
discounts.tier3: 10% off when the day's food total is ₹750 or more
discounts.bulk: Bulk plans add their own discount on every day's food: Week 5%, 15-Day 7.5%, Month 10% — and the daily tiers above stack on top.
discounts.loyalty_streak: Order 6 days in a row (Sundays and kitchen-closed days don't break the streak) and get a loyalty reward on day 6 — 5% of each streak day's food is given back.
discounts.review_promo: Leave a 5-star Google review and get an extra 10% off your next order.
discounts.note: All discounts are applied automatically when you place an order online.

options: UPI / Cards via secure HDFC payment gateway (instant)
payment.gateway: Payments are processed instantly through the HDFC SmartGateway — pay by UPI or card and your order confirms automatically, no screenshots or manual verification needed.

wallet.name: Svaadh Wallet
wallet.recharge: Recharge instantly (min ₹100) through the secure HDFC payment gateway on the order page — the balance credits immediately.
wallet.benefit: Enables 1-tap ordering without paying every time. Balance is visible at the top of the order page. If your balance covers part of an order, you can split — wallet pays what it can and the gateway collects the rest.
wallet.refunds: Order cancellations refund instantly to your Svaadh Wallet, or to your original payment method on request.

payment.on_account: Approved regular customers can order on account and settle their bill monthly (or per their agreed cycle) via the gateway — the order page shows a Pay Bill option when dues are ready.

ordering.platform: Website order form / PWA Mobile App
ordering.mobile_app: You can install our website as a mobile app (PWA) on your phone. Click 'Install App' on the home page or order page for a home-screen icon and fast access.
ordering.process: Open the order form → enter phone number → fill delivery address → pick dates on calendar → choose meals → review bill → pay via gateway (UPI/card), Wallet, or On Account.
ordering.live_tracking: Once an order is marked 'Out for Delivery' by our driver, you'll see a '🚗 Out for Delivery' badge in your 'View/Edit upcoming orders' dashboard.
ordering.advance_ordering: You can select multiple dates on the calendar to order for the whole week in one go — or use a Bulk plan (Week / 15-Day / Month) for automatic daily meals with a discount.
ordering.edit_cancel: You can cancel any order before its cutoff time using 'View/Edit existing orders' on the order form. Editing isn't available — cancel and re-place instead. Bulk 15-Day/Month days can also be POSTPONED to another date instead of cancelling.
ordering.no_login: No login needed — your phone number is your identity. Your address and details are saved for the next order.

vision: To make homemade vegetarian meals easily accessible and affordable for everyone, while maintaining taste, quality, and consistency.
